none: PAS NLM-526FE7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust probably helmeted left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: [Wolf suckling twins]. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 1.80gms, die axis: possibly 6
